what: A granular grand piano: the Salamander grand broken into grains. Eight presets with two macros each (SELECT, ALGORITHM), a smart HOLD, backwards grains, harmonic halos, textures (rain, vinyl, tape, wind, sea), MEMORY (your last phrase frozen into a cloud), PULSE in time with a MIDI clock, key pressure, and 15 scales, some between the keys (quarter tones, overtones, gamelan, Bohlen-Pierce).
